<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><pre>map "https://fhir.demo.smartregister.org/fhir/StructureMap/unicef-mexico-follow-up-visit" = 'Follow-up Visit'

uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/QuestionnaireResponse" as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" as target

// Main mapping group
group FollowupVisit(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> bundle.id = uuid() "r_bundle_id";
    src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "r_bundle_type";
    src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Consent') as consent, 
    create('Encounter') as encounter, evaluate(src, $this.subject) as refPatient then {
        //Consent given
        src.item as item where((linkId = "agreement-to-procedures" or linkId = "agreement-to-psychological-procedures") and answer.value.code = "373066001" ) then {
        src then SetYesConsentStatus(src, consent, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractEncounter(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),

                //Personal pathological history
                ExtractBloodType(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractChronicDegenerativeDiseases(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractCancerType(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherCancerType(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractSurgicalProcedures(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractIllnessesWithinTheLastYear(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherIllnessesWithinTheLastYear(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherDiseasesChoice(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherDiseases(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractTrauma(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractAllergies(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherAllergies(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractFoodAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherFoodAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractDrugAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherDrugAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractLocalAnestheticsAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractOtherMedicationsAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractAntibioticsAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractAnalgesicsAndAntiInflammatoriesAllergyIntolerance(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),

                // Gynecobstetric history
                ExtractAlreadyHadFirstMenstrualPeriod(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractMenarcheAge(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractRegularityOfMenstrualCycle(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractDateOfLastMenstrualPeriod(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractDateOfProbableDelivery(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractFundalHeight(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractFetalHeartRate(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractIsSexuallyActive(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractAgeBecameSexuallyActive(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractNumberOfSexualPartners(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractNumberOfPregnancies(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractNumberOfAbortions(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractNumberOfVaginalDeliveries(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractNumberOfCesareanSections(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractAdditionalComments(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                
                // Referral
                ExtractIsReferral(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractReasonForReferral(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),

                // Consultation
                ExtractReasonForConsultation(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle), 

                // Extract reason for psychological consultation
                ExtractReasonForPsychologicalConsultation(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),

                // Extract psychological observations (treatment provided)
                ExtractPsychologicalObservations(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                
                // Diagnoses 
                ExtractClinicalNutritionalDiagnosis(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),
                ExtractMedicalDiagnosis(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle),

                // Treatment provided
                ExtractTreatmentProvided(src, encounter, refPatient, bundle) "r_bundle_entries";
        } "r_cons_yes";

        //No consent given
        src.item as item where((linkId = "agreement-to-procedures" or linkId = "agreement-to-psychological-procedures") and answer.value.code = "373067005" ) then {
            src then SetNoConsentStatus(src, consent, refPatient, bundle) "r_set_no_consent";
        } "r_cons_no";
    } "r_extract_consent";
}

group ExtractEncounter(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target encounter: Encounter, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = encounter then {
        src -> encounter.id = uuid() "r_encounter_id";
        src -> encounter.status = 'finished' "r_encounter_status";
        src -> encounter.class = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode", "AMB") "r_encounter_class";
        src -> encounter.subject = patient "r_encounter_subject_ref";
        src -> encounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "https://smartregister.org/" "r_p_coding_system";
                src.item as visitTypeItem where(linkId = "follow-up-visit-type" and answer.exists()) then {
                    src->evaluate(visitTypeItem, $this.answer.value) as visitType then {
                        // Default visit type
                        src -> coding.code = "FOLLOW_UP_VISIT" "r_p_coding_code";
                        src -> coding.display = "Follow-up Visit" "r_p_coding_display";

                        src where(visitType = "PFV") then {
                            src -> coding.code = "PREGNANCY_FOLLOW_UP_VISIT" "r_p_coding_code";
                            src -> coding.display = "Pregnancy Follow-up Visit" "r_p_coding_display";
                        } "r_visit_type_pregnancy";
                        src where(visitType = "CFV") then {
                            src -> coding.code = "CHILD_FOLLOW_UP_VISIT" "r_p_coding_code";
                            src -> coding.display = "Child Follow-up Visit" "r_p_coding_display";
                        } "r_visit_type_child";
                        src where(visitType = "LFV") then {
                            src -> coding.code = "LACTATING_FOLLOW_UP_VISIT" "r_p_coding_code";
                            src -> coding.display = "Lactating Follow-up Visit" "r_p_coding_display";
                        } "r_visit_type_lactating";
                    } "r_visit_type_item";
                } "r_follow_up_visit_type";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
        } "r_en_type";
        src -> encounter.priority = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActPriority" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "EL" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "elective" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = 'elective' "r_en_prio_text";
        } "r_en_prio";
        src -> encounter.participant as participant then {
            src -> participant.type = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ParticipationType", "PPRF") "r_encounter_participant_type";
            src -> participant.individual = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_encounter_practitioner_ref";
        } "r_encounter_participant";
        src -> encounter.period = create('Period') as period then {
            src -> period.start = evaluate(src, now()) "r_encounter_period_start";
            src -> period.end = evaluate(src, now()) "r_encounter_period_end";
        } "r_encounter_period";
        src->encounter.reasonCode = create("CodeableConcept") as reasonConcept then {
            src -> encounter.status = "finished" "r_en_st_com";
            src->reasonConcept.text = "Follow-up visit" "r_enc_resonCode_text";
            src-> reasonConcept.coding = create("Coding") as reasoncoding then {
                src->reasoncoding.system = "http://snomed.info/sct",
                reasoncoding.code ="185389009",
                reasoncoding.display = "Follow-up visit" "r_enc_resonCode_coding_value";
            } "r_enc_resonCode_coding";
        }"r_enc_resonCode";
    } "r_extract_encounter";
}

group SetYesConsentStatus(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target consent: Consent, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> consent.status = 'active' "r_consent_status";
    src then ExtractConsent(src, consent, patient, bundle) "r_extract_consent";
}

group SetNoConsentStatus(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target consent: Consent, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> consent.status = 'rejected' "r_consent_status";
    src then ExtractConsent(src, consent, patient, bundle) "r_extract_consent";
}

// Extract Consent Data
group ExtractConsent(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target consent: Consent, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as consentItem where(linkId = "agreement-to-procedures") then {
            src -> consent.id = uuid() "r_consent_id";
            src -> consent.scope = cc("http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/consent-scope", "patient-privacy", "Privacy Consent") "r_consent_scope";
            src -> consent.category = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/consentcategorycodes", "57016-8", "Privacy policy acknowledgment") "r_consent_category";
            src -> consent.patient = patient "r_consent_patient";
            src -> consent.dateTime = evaluate(src, now()) "r_consent_datetime";
            src -> consent.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_cns_performer";
            src -> consent.organization = create('Reference') as orgRef then {
                src -> orgRef.reference = evaluate(src, 'Organization/' + $this.managingOrganization) "org";
            } "r_cns_org";
             src -> consent.source = create('Reference') as consentSource then {
                    src -> consentSource.reference = evaluate(src, 'QuestionnaireResponse/' + src.id) "source";
            } "r_cns_source";
    } "r_consent_item";
}

group ExtractBloodType(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, source encounter: Encounter, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as bloodTypeItem where(linkId = "blood-group-and-rh-factor" and answer.exists()) then {
        bloodTypeItem.answer as answer then {
            src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as observation then {  
                src -> observation.id = uuid() "r_observation_id";
                src -> observation.status = "final" "r_observation_status";
                src -> observation.category = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category", "laboratory") "r_observation_category";
                src -> observation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
                    src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                        src -> coding.system = "http://snomed.info/sct" "r_observation_code_system";  
                        src -> coding.code = "365642005" "r_observation_code_code";
                        src -> coding.display = "Blood group antigen type" "r_observation_code_display";
                    } "r_observation_code";
                    src -> concept.text = "Blood group antigen type" "r_observation_code_text";
                } "r_observation_code"; 
                src -> observation.subject = patient "r_observation_subject";
                src -> observation.encounter = reference(encounter) "r_observation_encounter";
                src -> observation.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_observation_performer";
                src -> observation.value = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
                    src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {   
                        src -> coding.system = evaluate(bloodTypeItem, $this.answer.value.system) "r_observation_value_system";
                        src -> coding.code = evaluate(bloodTypeItem, $this.answer.value.code) "r_observation_value_code";
                        src -> coding.display = evaluate(bloodTypeItem, $this.answer.value.display) "r_observation_value_display";
                    } "r_observation_value";
                    src -> concept.text = evaluate(bloodTypeItem, $this.answer.value.display) "r_observation_value_text";
                } "r_observation_value";    
            } "r_extract_blood_type";
        } "r_blood_type_answer";
    } "r_blood_type_item";
}

group ExtractChronicDegenerativeDiseases(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, source encounter: Encounter, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as conditionItem where(linkId = "chronic-degenerative-diseases" and answer.exists()) then {
        conditionItem.answer as answer then {
            src->evaluate(answer, $this.value.code) as answerCode then {
                src where(answerCode != "G31.89") then {
                    src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Condition') as condition then {
                        src -> condition.id = uuid() "r_condition_id";
                        src -> condition.clinicalStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical", "active") "r_condition_clinical_status";
                        src -> condition.verificationStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status", "confirmed") "r_condition_verification_status";
                        src -> condition.category = cc("https://smartregister.org/", "chronic-problem-list-item") "r_condition_category";
                        src -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
                            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                                src -> coding.system = evaluate(answer, answer.value.system) "r_condition_code_system";
                                src -> coding.code = answerCode "r_condition_code_code";
                                src -> coding.display = evaluate(answer, answer.value.display) "r_condition_code_display";
                            } "r_condition_code";
                            src -> concept.text = evaluate(answer, answer.value.display) "r_condition_code_text";
                        } "r_condition_code";
                        src -> condition.subject = patient "r_condition_subject";
                        src -> condition.encounter = reference(encounter) "r_condition_encounter";
                        src -> condition.recordedDate = evaluate(src, now()) "r_condition_recordedDate";
                        src -> condition.recorder = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_condition_recorder";
                    } "r_extract_condition";
                } "r_condition_answer_code_not_chronic";
            } "r_condition_answer_code";
        } "r_condition_answer";
    } "r_condition_item";
}

                    } "r_condition_code";

        } "r_condition_answer";
    } "r_condition_item";
}

}

group ExtractOtherDiseasesChoice(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, source encounter: Encounter, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as illnessItem where(linkId = "other-diseases-choice" and answer.exists()) then {
        illnessItem.answer as answer then {
            src where(answer.value.code != "other") then {
                src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Condition') as condition then {
                    src -> condition.id = uuid() "r_condition_id";  
                    src -> condition.clinicalStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical", "active") "r_condition_clinical_status";
                    src -> condition.verificationStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status", "confirmed") "r_condition_verification_status";
                    src -> condition.category = cc("https://smartregister.org/", "other-disease-problem-list-item") "r_condition_category"; 
                    src -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
                        src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                            src -> coding.system = evaluate(answer, answer.value.system) "r_condition_code_system";
                            src -> coding.code = evaluate(answer, answer.value.code) "r_condition_code_code";
                            src -> coding.display = evaluate(answer, answer.value.display) "r_condition_code_display";
                        } "r_condition_code";   
                        src -> concept.text = evaluate(answer, answer.value.display) "r_condition_code_text";
                    } "r_condition_code";
                    src -> condition.subject = patient "r_condition_subject";
